name: Tablet Experience
author: maxt
description: Laptop/Tablet mode for detachable 2-in-1s: sensor-following rotation (auto + explicit fixed angles), virtual-keyboard toggle (SUPER+U / bar button / 3-finger tap) on the desktop and lock/login screens with a visible ▼ collapse key, input-method quick switch (EN/中), voice input, offline handwriting input (stylus/finger ink panel, SUPER+I), laptop display reset, a simplified tablet bar with per-icon toggles, and a tablet window-manage popup.

barWidget.displayName: Tablet mode + keyboard + IME + voice + handwriting + window
barWidget.description: Laptop/Tablet toggle + rotation + tablet window manage (close/move) + virtual-keyboard show/hide + handwriting input (offline pen/finger panel) + input-method quick switch + voxtype voice input (all tablet only)
